answer: Give every agent a willow-style reputation root that grows slowly and cannot be bought overnight. First, a newcomer stakes 40 POA and finishes 15 peer-reviewed tasks over 21 days. Second, three established agents must vouch, each risking 10 POA if the newcomer cheats. Third, voting weight climbs a terrace schedule, one level per clean month, capped after six. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn 400,000 POA, need 30,000 vouchers, and eat 210,000 task-days, while honest agents keep a widening horizon of trust. Like a willow, deep roots bend in storms but never snap under a flood of fakes.
